item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"01","ready":false,"issues":["Unsupported feasibility claim: the argument calls vendor workflow descriptions “credible feasibility signals” without a matching check.","Overstated accessibility claim: Newton being open source does not establish that NVIDIA is making the simulation stack more accessible.","Unsupported Newton characterization: the brief calls Newton an open simulation layer for physical systems, but its cited claim establishes only NVIDIA’s statement that it is open source.","Incomplete locator support: 01-c2’s quote does not include the model-based-definition annotations asserted in the statement.","Malformed written locator: 01-c3’s quoted text crosses a newline, which policy forbids.","Insufficient locator support: 01-c3’s locator supports app-store availability but not that the agent can set up and run simulations.","Partial locator support: 01-c4’s quote omits the one-prompt context and returning results asserted in the statement.","Transcript attribution error: 01-c6 treats a podcast’s automatic-transcript report as a reported fact rather than an attributed report requiring underlying evaluation/video verification.","Catch-all inference: 01-c7 combines reduced handoffs, production readiness, feature correctness, and solver-setup validity under one claim.","Unsupported absence claim: 01-c7 says the cited sources report no independent checks, but its focused locators do not establish that absence.","Overbroad synthesis: it combines Onshape, SimScale, and NVIDIA observations into one architectural conclusion without separately stated producer facts and a narrowly scoped inference."]}
